title: Annotation review
description: Which frames two reviewers must settle before a label revision can freeze. The whole small corpus uses entire. A larger corpus may name a sample. Difficult disagreements are added by the command and are not listed here.

review_id.description: Stable name of this review plan.

authority.description: Who may settle a disagreement. Both reviewers name this authority.

coverage.description: entire reviews every disagreement. sample reviews the listed frames plus difficult ones.

items.description: Predeclared instance frames. Empty when coverage is entire.

x-rules.sample: coverage entire has an empty items list. coverage sample may be empty, which reviews only difficult disagreements. A frame is listed once.

frame_index.description: Zero-based frame index in the decoded source.
